d: Discover the fascinating history of Gorakhnath Math, Guru Gorakhnath and the Nath Sampradaya in this episode of The Lallantop's Tareekh. From legendary stories of Guru Gorakhnath's miraculous powers and Hatha Yoga to the origins of Gorakhpur, explore the history of Nath Yogis, Matsyendranath, Kanphata Yogis and the ancient Nath tradition. We also uncover the historical journey of Gorakhnath Temple, its destruction and reconstruction, the role of Mahant Digvijay Nath and Mahant Avaidyanath, and its growing religious and political influence.
